248: Come and behold, "Moses speaks" from what is written, (Shir Hashirim 1:15) "Behold, you are fair my love" and written, (Shir Hashirim 4:3) "Like a strand of scarlet, your lips are." And God (Elohim) answers him by voice, as written, (Shir Hashirim 1:16) "Behold, you are handsome my beloved yes, you are pleasant" and written, (Shir Hashirim 5:13) "His lips are like lillies, dripping flowing myrrh"
